segments.text: Grep from 1973 finds exact text matches.
Your codebase in 2026 needs semantic understanding. Grepi indexes your code using vector embeddings so you can search by meaning user authentication
flow instead of regex patterns. Built for AI agents so they get better context with fewer searches. Auto boosting deprioritizes tests and mocks.
Prioritizes actual source code. Has call graph tracing to find what calls what.
runs as an MCP server, so Claude can use it natively.
